§ 10.11 Contracting agency requirements.
§ 10.11 Contracting agency requirements.
(a) 
Contract clause.
(b) 
Failure to include the contract clause.
(c) 
Withholding.
(d) 
Actions on complaints
Reporting
Reporting time frame.
(ii) 
Report contents.
(A) Complaint of contractor noncompliance with Executive Order 13658 or this part;

(B) Available statements by the worker, contractor, or any other person regarding the alleged violation;

(C) Evidence that the Executive Order minimum wage contract clause was included in the contract;

(D) Information concerning known settlement negotiations between the parties, if applicable; and

(E) Any other relevant facts known to the contracting agency or other information requested by the Wage and Hour Division.

(2) [Reserved]
